about.title: About Alokito Poribesh Foundation
about.subtitle: A community-focused organization driving environmental action.
about.historyText: Alokito Poribesh Foundation began as a voluntary initiative by environmental enthusiasts wishing to reverse environmental degradation in local communities. Over time, it has evolved into a structured foundation supporting tree plantations, waste management campaigns, and environmental education across Bangladesh. We believe that real progress starts from the ground up—one seed, one cleanup, and one community at a time.
about.missionText: To build sustainable community models, educate the youth on conservation, and run field-level campaigns to create a clean, green, and habitable environment.
about.visionText: An enlightened society where every individual acts responsibly towards nature, ensuring environmental harmony for generations to come.
about.transparencyDesc: We publish open reports, share raw impact data, and verify everything we do.
about.sustainabilityDesc: Designing solutions that are long-term, ecological, and locally reproducible.
about.youthActionDesc: Empowering students and young leaders to take ownership of environmental problems.

donate.whyDonateText: Every donation is directly used to buy saplings, secure cleanup equipment, and host youth workshops. We maintain 100% financial transparency. Financial statements are audited and visible to the public.
